title: Flow canvas: decision edge labels print the whole CEL condition and overlap (campaign_enrollment)
body:
## Source

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FlowCanvas.tsx` labels a branch edge with `edge.isDefault ? 'else' : cond ? \`if ${cond}\` : edge.label` and draws the string at the edge midpoint. On HotCRM "Enroll Members in Campaign" (`campaign_enrollment`, Automations pillar, 100 % zoom, 1482 px) the two edges out of "Campaign Open?" carry `if has(vars.campaignRecord) && has(vars.campaignRecord.status) && (vars.campaignRecord.status == "planning" || vars.campaignRecord.status == "in_progress") && vars.memberSource != "contacts"` (147 characters) and its `== "contacts"` twin; the two strings run across each other and across the "Find Eligible Leads" and "Find Eligible Contacts" nodes, and neither can be read.

## Target

1. An edge label is one line of at most 32 characters: the edge's own label when it has one, otherwise `if ` followed by the condition clamped with an ellipsis; `else` unchanged. The label sits in a pill on the canvas background so it never draws over a node card or another label.
2. The full condition is in the pill's `title` and in the edge inspector (`FlowEdgeInspector.tsx`), which already edits it.
3. Labels longer than the pill wrap nowhere; the pill's width is capped at the node width (260 px on the artboard `automations.html`).

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FlowCanvas.tsx` (branch label), `flow-canvas-parts.tsx` if the label element lives there, tests beside them.

## Acceptance

1. A test gives a decision edge a 150-character condition and asserts the rendered label is at most 32 characters plus the ellipsis with the full condition in `title`; a second asserts an edge with its own label shows that label unclamped when it fits.
2. `campaign_enrollment` at 1280 px before/after, light and dark: both labels legible, no overlap.
3. Every `FlowCanvas.*.test.tsx` and `flow-problems.*.test.ts` green.

## Constraints

- No change to edge semantics, routing or the inspector's editing.
- Lands after #12454, whose claim names presentation-only edits to `FlowCanvas.tsx`; rebase on it.
